reviews.text: The wood-fired margherita was incredible and our server Jo was so friendly and attentive. Perfect anniversary dinner.
Delicious short rib and a great wine list. It got a little loud once the dining room filled up, but we'd come back.
We waited 45 minutes for our mains and my pasta arrived cold. The staff were kind about it but nobody offered to fix it.
My wife got sick after eating the chicken here. Pretty sure it was undercooked. We are calling the health department.
Amazing tiramisu! One note for the kitchen: I mentioned I'm allergic to tree nuts and the dessert still came with pistachio crumble. I caught it in time, and everything else was perfect.
Fine, nothing special. Service was slow.
